security_audit.summary: Most static command and URL detections are Markdown documentation false positives. However, the skill explicitly directs users to expose a real Chrome profile through remote debugging and reuse authenticated OAuth sessions. This creates critical session and account-access risk if automation receives untrusted instructions.

remediation.issue: The skill directs users to automate a real default Chrome profile through remote debugging.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the personal profile example. Require a dedicated, non-sensitive automation profile with no existing cookies or authenticated accounts.

remediation.issue: Remote debugging is presented as a way to reuse Google and Discord sessions.
remediation.suggestion: Warn that CDP grants broad browser control. Require explicit user confirmation before connecting to a browser with active sessions.

remediation.issue: The documentation contains an author-specific local profile path.
remediation.suggestion: Replace it with a generic placeholder and explain how to create an isolated browser profile.

content.user_title: Automate Browser Tasks with Agent Browser
content.value_statement: Web tasks can require many repeated clicks, form entries, and page checks. Agent Browser provides structured CLI commands for navigation, interaction, extraction, and visual capture.
actual_capabilities: Open pages, move through browser history, and wait for page states.
Click, fill, select, upload, and use keyboard or mouse interactions.
Capture accessibility snapshots, text, HTML, attributes, screenshots, and PDFs.
Find elements by role, text, label, placeholder, alt text, title, or test ID.
Run isolated named browser sessions and return machine-readable snapshot output.
Support headed mode for visual debugging of browser tasks.
limitations: It requires the Agent Browser CLI and its browser dependencies to be installed.
Element references change after navigation and require a new snapshot.
Website authentication, anti-bot controls, and permissions can prevent automation.
Do not connect it to a personal browser profile or active authenticated sessions.

use_cases.title: Test a web form
use_cases.description: Navigate a staging page, complete a form, and confirm the expected success message.

use_cases.title: Collect page content
use_cases.description: Open approved pages and extract visible text or selected attributes for a research workflow.

use_cases.title: Debug a UI workflow
use_cases.description: Use snapshots and headed mode to identify controls and reproduce an interaction issue.

prompt_templates.title: Open and inspect a page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Agent Browser to open this approved URL, take an interactive snapshot, and list the main controls you find.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a test form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Agent Browser on the staging URL. Fill the provided test values, submit the form, and report the visible confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Extract selected information
prompt_templates.prompt: Open these approved pages with Agent Browser. Extract the title and the specified visible fields, then provide a short comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Verify an end-to-end flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use an isolated browser session to test this staging workflow. Snapshot after each navigation, verify each expected state, and report failures with screenshots.

output_examples.input: Inspect a product page and identify the purchase controls.
output: Interactive snapshot found a quantity selector and an Add to Cart button.
A screenshot was saved for review.

output_examples.input: Test a newsletter form on a staging site.
output: The email field accepted the test address.
Submission displayed the expected confirmation message.

output_examples.input: Extract the visible headings from an approved page.
output: Section headings: New features, Reliability, and Support.

best_practices: Use only approved URLs and test accounts for automated workflows.
Take a new snapshot after every navigation before using element references.
Use isolated sessions and dedicated browser profiles without personal login data.
anti_patterns: Do not connect to a personal Chrome profile or reuse active OAuth sessions.
Do not submit forms or perform purchases without explicit user approval.
Do not reuse element references after a page navigation.

faq.question: What does Agent Browser do?
faq.answer: It provides command-line browser automation for navigation, interaction, extraction, snapshots, screenshots, and testing.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: How do I select page elements?
faq.answer: Use a snapshot to obtain references, or locate elements by role, text, label, placeholder, alt text, title, or test ID.

faq.question: Why should I take a new snapshot after navigation?
faq.answer: Element references are stable only for the current page load and can change after navigation.

faq.question: Can I use my existing Chrome login session?
faq.answer: Do not use personal or active authenticated sessions. Use a dedicated isolated profile and explicit test accounts.

faq.question: Can it test pages visually?
faq.answer: Yes. Headed mode can display the browser, and the tool can create screenshots for review.
